name: cpf-input
description: Input field for Brazilian CPF (individual taxpayer number) with automatic mask and mod11 validation

onChange.description: Called with the new masked value

context.whenToUse: When collecting a Brazilian individual's tax identification number (CPF). Required for purchases, account creation, and virtually all transactions in Brazil.
context.whenNotToUse: For company tax IDs, use CNPJInput instead. For foreign tax IDs, use a generic tax ID field.
context.accessibility: Announces format hint ('Formato: 000.000.000-00') to screen readers. Validation result is announced as a live region.
context.culturalNote: CPF (Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas) is a unique 11-digit taxpayer identification number assigned to every Brazilian citizen and resident. It is required for virtually all financial transactions, purchases, and government services in Brazil.
